title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Amendment Act 2014

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014.
(KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA ACT NO.XIX OF
2014)
AN
ACT
to
amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013
WHEREAS
it is expedient to
amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance Act, 2013 (Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XXI of 2013), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement:-- (1)
This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Finance
(Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
